rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges static-image limits, but it overstates confidence in ICM/TE quality and symmetry from this single focal plane; some described features are not clearly discernible in the image.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, PCOS, ovarian response, endometrium, semen parameters, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo morphology and prognosis, correctly emphasizing age-related aneuploidy risk.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied mainly to age and untested ploidy status; only minor overreach in linking some factors such as PCOS/endometrial synchrony without cycle hormone details.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET, luteal support, and consideration of PGT-A; slight limitation is presenting implantation/live birth estimates without clarifying center-specific variability.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, monitoring, and future planning, including review of cycle details and uterine/metabolic evaluation, though some advice remains somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
